ThingDef.label: STC fragment (armiger conversion beam cannon)
ThingDef.description: A fragment of a Standard Template Construct, the lost design data for the armiger conversion beam cannon. Study 1 fragment(s) at a Mechanicum manufactorum to recover the pattern, after which the weapon can be forged. Fragments are found in ancient ruins, offered as rewards, or sold by exotic traders.
